LanguageData.Raven_Ability_DevourPawn.label: [Raven] Devour (Internal Sealing)
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_DevourPawn.description: Using the Raven race's unique biology and rigorous training, the caster forcibly swallows a humanoid target within range, achieving the ultimate "internal sealing". The prey, completely enveloped in warm mucous membranes and bodily fluids, is frozen in time.
